description.zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~86912~~)接口查看可用的地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID.

> For more information, see [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) to view available region IDs.

description.zh:
IP白名单分组下的IP列表，最多1000个，以逗号隔开，格式如下：
- 10.23.12.24（IP）
- 10.23.12.24/24（CIDR模式，无类域间路由，`/24`表示地址中前缀的长度，范围为`[1,32]`）
description.en:
The list of IP addresses for the whitelist. Up to 1,000 IP addresses are supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas. The following formats are supported:

- 10.23.12.24 (IP address)

- 10.23.12.24/24 (A CIDR block, where `/24` indicates the prefix length. The prefix length must be an integer in the range `[1,32]`.)

description.zh: 是否修改数据库5432端口的白名单，默认true
description.en: Specifies whether to modify the whitelist for database port 5432. The default value is true.

description.zh: 是否修改http 80和https 443端口的白名单，默认true
description.en: Specifies whether to modify the whitelist for HTTP port 80 and HTTPS port 443. The default value is true.

descriptions.zh: 在开始使用Supabase实例前，您需要将客户端的IP地址或IP地址段添加到Supabase实例的白名单中。
descriptions.en: Before you use a Supabase instance, you must add the client's IP address or IP address segment to the instance's whitelist.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb modify-supabase-project-security-ips --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --security-ip-list 127.0.0.1 --project-id sbp-4070000 --update-db true --update-web true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb ModifySupabaseProjectSecurityIps --region cn-hangzhou --SecurityIPList '127.0.0.1' --ProjectId 'sbp-4070000' --UpdateDb true --UpdateWeb true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
